This product is supplied without battery and charger. 18V battery required (sold separately, see product code 853FJ).

High performance Milwaukee M18 jobsite audio system features a DAB+/FM tuner with digital processor to deliver high reception accuracy and signal clarity. Includes a digital Bluetooth receiver, playing music up to 36m away from smartphone, computer or tablet. Dual 8.9cm woofers provide clear, balanced sound, further enhanced by a customisable equalizer. Jobsite radio includes 18 DAB+ station presets, integrated handles for easy transport, and onboard storage for phones. Shock absorbing end caps and metal speaker grills protect from drops, water and debris on the jobsite. Protected USB-C power outlet for device charging in both AC and DC modes. Flexible battery system compatible with all M18 batteries. Provides up to 13 hours of run time when used with M18B5 Redlithium 5.0Ah battery (sold separately).
